analyst.summary: Birlasoft, a mid-cap IT services provider focused on banking, insurance and life-sciences clients, saw revenue stay roughly flat in FY26 amid an industry-wide slowdown in discretionary technology spending, but operating margins have recovered meaningfully over the past three quarters (from around 12% to 16-18%) and the balance sheet remains debt-free. The stock trades at an inexpensive valuation for that quality. We rate it a Hold.
